correctness.rationale: Greedy-arch equivalence proved by the last-first-appearing-symbol obstruction; iid geometric arch durations follow from the ternary adjacent-distinct Markov source. A negative-binomial/binomial-tail identity proves all n,k count formulas, a renewal series proves the bivariate GF, and classical independent-sum LLN/CLT prove the limits. Finite checks supplement rather than replace proofs.

value.rationale: Exact universal-subsequence coverage under mandatory symbol alternation is a natural constrained decoding/coverage invariant. The binomial-tail formula gives arbitrary-length thresholds and exact coverage probabilities without enumerating exponentially many words; iid arch lengths reveal a renewal structure and exact mean/variance/normal fluctuations. The infinite-length structural law is appreciably more informative than isolated finite counts and is not only a renamed unrestricted-word identity.
